svg.metadata: General Program roadmap: a new goal-led layout of the publicly readable 2022 bearing proposal, award 52275119. Layout inspired by the BioSoph templates in the XJTU library publication PDF pages 2 and 6, and the public WeChat-reprinted discussion at paper.dxy.cn/article/897996. No source artwork copied. Dashed return arrows denote experimental calibration. See references/mianshang-layouts.md and references/funded-cases.md. Multicolor module variant; explicit flat fills and darker same-hue boundaries. Layout and text unchanged.
